requirements: Is there exactly one single painting of Grump Hollow with a pond shown?
Are there exactly nine small muffin wrappers visible in the painting?
Is the first muffin wrapper located in the lower left part of the big muddy clearing?
Do the nine muffin wrappers form a loose trail running from the lower left clearing toward the upper left?
Do the muffin wrappers continue their trail up to the old soggy wooden bench in the top left nook?
Do the muffin wrappers continue from the bench up the narrow path leading into the trees at the top left corner?
Is the last muffin wrapper positioned where the narrow path ends in the top left?
Does each muffin wrapper appear as a pleated paper liner that is cream and pale golden brown?
Are the muffin wrappers crumpled and flattened with visible cake crumbs and a smear of mud?
Does each muffin wrapper lie flat on the ground with a soft painted contact shadow?
